column2: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
column3: What temperature does water boil? Here's how long it takes and more
column4: As water boils at this temperature, it changes from a liquid to a gas. That gas, or water vapor can continue to rise in temperature. Liquid water however becomes unstable at 212 degrees Fahrenheit or 100 Celsius and cannot “boil” in as it will have already transformed into water vapor.
